notes: Hand-assembled, not generated by `tubuild.py create`: tu_map cannot segment arm9/main, so there was no candidate id to create from. The schema follows the arm9/dExtBlendAnmModel_c and arm9/dCcAc_c entries, which took the same route.

dExtAnmModel_c is the first multiply-inheriting class in the tree (dExtSimpleModel_c + Animation, Animation at +0x50): the animated-model base that scene objects embed as a member subobject. Copy is the first real MI argument conversion; SetAnim switches BCA files with a fast same-file path; func_020167a4 is the file-local bones-only refresh daMoray_c also calls on a dExtBlendAnmModel_c*.

The lifecycle (D2, D0, D1, C1, C2 at 0x0201689c..0x020169d8) is folded. One dExtAnmModel_c() and one ~dExtAnmModel_c() emit all five variants. The _ZThn80_ thunks at 0x02017168..0x020171c8 are enrolled in src/engine/model/ModelAnimThunks.cpp and are deadstrip-duplicate here.

Defining the destructor emits the MI vtable group. The secondary preamble is inside _ZTV14dExtAnmModel_c's compared extent (next symbol VTable_Animation_ModelAnimThunk at 0x0208e9a4). RTTI stays on so the offset-to-top word is the literal -0x50. The family carries the cartridge RTTI spellings (notes/model-rtti-names.md), so the emitted _ZTI/_ZTS records for dExtAnmModel_c, dExtSimpleModel_c and dExtModel_c compare directly against their arm9 homes before they are discarded.

func_020167a4 folds in as a file-local extern "C" function typed on dExtAnmModel_c*: it reads file@0x60, currFrame@0x58 and data@0x08 through the object, and daMoray_c declares it extern "C" with a dExtBlendAnmModel_c* -- keeping the label keeps that caller working untouched.

SetAnim stays a mangled extern "C" definition (wall 6az, notes/mwccarm-codegen.md): the Fix12<int> by-value parameter keeps the member declaration from being the definable spelling; dExtAnmModel_c.h's declaration is the real one.
